Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.

Repeat each combat phase.

When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.

2034-5571-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
2034-5571-6922--6.description:

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.

Resolve the Phantom Train ability.

Resolve the Quarry Hauler trigger, putting a divinity counter on Myojin of Life's Web.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Quarry Hauler and the additional creature to your hand from the battlefield.

Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.

If Vigor died this way, it triggers, shuffling itself into your library.
Atla triggers once for each creature that died.
Resolve the first Atla trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card, then putting the creature card onto the battlefield and all other revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining Atla trigger.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Mirror Entity ability.
